name: Koori Cold Stores
description: Koori Cold Stores is a landing theme for a regional cold-storage operator at Northmere Port. The long front page opens on a cross-fading low-key dock photograph with a ring pager and a tilted line, then a room-log strip, a patina band that fades into the page with three fused text-and-photo cards, a parallax dock band, a four-step booking list, a sideways day strip, a rate table and one capacity enquiry. Schibsted Grotesk for headings and Onest for reading. Works without WooCommerce. WCAG AA colours.

fonts.role: display: the catch line, section words, card titles, figures and the wordmark (variable 400 to 900, Latin subset)

summary.en: A cold-storage operator: a cross-fading dock hero with a ring pager and tilted line, a room-log strip, a patina band fading into white cards that fuse text and photo, a parallax dock band and one capacity enquiry.
